run_detect_contact: run the MuJoCo simulation to detect hand-object contact points from a trajectory dataset
run_detect_contact_no_viewer: run contact detection on a dataset without launching the MuJoCo viewer
run_detect_contact_save_video: run contact detection and save the simulation as an MP4 video file
run_detect_contact_plot: run contact detection and plot the contact sequence for each fingertip
run_detect_contact_single_hand: run contact detection for a single hand embodiment type like right or left
